referencePeriod.period: annual: 1 January to 31 December of the preceding year
referencePeriod.basis: Art. 4(1): statement published by 30 June each year, covering 1 January until 31 December of the preceding year.
referencePeriod.averaging: Art. 6(3): the 'Impact' column is the average of impacts on 31 March, 30 June, 30 September and 31 December.

indicators.fundUnitNote: Not stated in Table 1. Formula (1) sums investee Scope(x) GHG emissions weighted by current value of investment / enterprise value; GHG emissions are defined via Regulation (EU) 2018/842 (CO2 equivalent), so the unit is tonnes of CO2 equivalent.
Formula (2): denominator 'current value of all investments (€M)'.
Formula (3): investee Scope 1, 2 and 3 GHG emissions / 'investee company's €M revenue', weighted by share of investment value.
